name: (Ricardo) Tag Zoom webinar attendance by engagement thresholds in KlickTipp

parameters.content:
Community Node Disclaimer: This workflow uses KlickTipp community nodes.


### Introduction
This workflow automates the end-to-end integration between Zoom Webinars and KlickTipp using n8n. It listens to Zoom webinar events (specifically, when a webinar ends), fetches all participants and absentees, and gives every registrant exactly one attendance result in KlickTipp: attended (optionally fully attended) or not attended. This enables precise segmentation for follow-ups and campaign automation based on actual user engagement.

### Benefits
- **Fully automated tagging**: No manual effort—participants and no-shows are tagged in KlickTipp automatically after every webinar.
- **Complete segmentation**: Every registrant ends up in exactly one segment—attended, fully attended or not attended. Nobody falls through the gaps.
- **Safe for existing contacts**: Existing KlickTipp contacts only receive tags; names and subscription status stay untouched.
- **Multi-webinar support**: Handles any number of webinars (e.g. Beginner vs. Expert) via one configuration list.

### Key Features
- **Zoom Webhook Listener**:
  - Reacts to `webinar.ended` events.
  - Validates Zoom URL on webhook registration using HMAC.
  - Answers Zoom immediately and waits 60 seconds before fetching data, so the past webinar report is available.
- **Zoom API Integration**:
  - Pulls **all** participants and **all** absentees of the past webinar (paginated, `page_size=300`, `next_page_token`).
  - Encodes the webinar UUID as required by Zoom (double encoding for UUIDs starting with `/` or containing `//`).
- **Attendance Logic** (Code node "Aggregate and classify"):
  - Filters out internal users (e.g. host and panelists) and entries without an e-mail address.
  - Merges rejoins of the same person and sums up their durations.
  - Measures attendance against the **actual** webinar length (`end_time - start_time`), fallback: scheduled duration.
  - Classifies each person as attended, fully attended (> 90%) or not attended (absentee or below an optional minimum).
- **KlickTipp Subscription & Tagging**:
  - Existing contact: adds the attended tag only.
  - New contact: subscribes via the opt-in process with first and last name from Zoom and the attended tag.
  - Adds the full attendance tag above the threshold.
  - Tags absentees as not attended (existing contacts only).
  - Stops visibly on lookup errors other than "contact not found" (e.g. authentication or rate limits).
- **Scalable Structure**:
  - Add more webinars by adding one entry (topic + three tag IDs) to the `WEBINARS` list—no new branches needed.

### Setup Instructions
**Zoom Preparation**
   - Ensure Zoom API access is enabled.
   - Set up webinars or recurring webinars with registration.
   - Enable webhook event `webinar.ended` for your Zoom webhook and the scopes `webinar:read:webinar`, `webinar:read:list_past_participants` and `webinar:read:list_absentees`.
   - Enter the **Secret Token** of your Zoom app in the Crypto node.

**KlickTipp Preparation**
   - Manually add the following tags per webinar:
     - `Zoom webinar E-Mail Zustellung für Anfänger attended`
     - `Zoom webinar E-Mail Zustellung für Anfänger attended fully`
     - `Zoom webinar E-Mail Zustellung für Anfänger not attended`
     - `Zoom webinar E-Mail Zustellung für Experten attended`
     - `Zoom webinar E-Mail Zustellung für Experten attended fully`
     - `Zoom webinar E-Mail Zustellung für Experten not attended`
   - Select the opt-in process (`listId`) for new contacts in the node "Subscribe new participant".

**n8n Configuration**
   - Configure the webhook node for the Zoom endpoint and connect it to your webhook.
   - Set up API credentials for Zoom and KlickTipp.
   - Edit the `WEBINARS` list at the top of the Code node "Aggregate and classify": one entry per webinar with a part of the webinar topic and the three tag IDs (`attended`, `full`, `notAttended`). The workflow stops with a clear error message as long as a tag ID is missing.
   - Optional: adjust `FULL_ATTENDANCE_RATIO` (default 0.9) and `MIN_ATTENDANCE_RATIO` (default 0 = every join counts as attended).

### Testing and Deployment
1. Register at least two test contacts for a Zoom webinar connected to the flow.
2. Join with one test contact (once with a rejoin, if possible), leave the other one absent, then end the webinar.
3. Verify:
   - The webhook triggers and the workflow continues after 60 seconds.
   - Participants and absentees are fetched from Zoom.
   - The attending contact receives the attended tag (and the full attendance tag above 90%).
   - The absent contact receives the not attended tag.
   - Existing contacts keep their names; new contacts are created with the Zoom name.

> 💡 *Pro Tip*: The pinned test data on the webhook and the two Zoom nodes lets you run the classification without a live webinar.

### Known Limitations
- **Recurring webinars**: Zoom reports participants and absentees per occurrence (UUID), so each occurrence is evaluated separately—make sure the tags fit your campaign logic for repeated dates.
- **Absentees unknown to KlickTipp**: no-shows are only tagged if the contact already exists in KlickTipp.
- **Large webinars**: if Zoom reports are not complete after 60 seconds, increase the wait time.

### Campaign Expansion Ideas
- Trigger personalized follow-up sequences in KlickTipp based on the attendance tags (e.g. replay for no-shows, offer for attendees).
- Combine this workflow with the Zoom registration workflow for full-funnel automation (registration tag, webinar start and join URL).
- Use the full attendance tag to target highly engaged participants with special offers.

### Customization
- Adjust the thresholds via `FULL_ATTENDANCE_RATIO` and `MIN_ATTENDANCE_RATIO` in the Code node.
- Change the wait time after `webinar.ended` for very large webinars.
- Use more granular attendance segments by extending the classification in the Code node (e.g. 0–30%, 30–60%) and adding tag IDs per segment.

nodes.name: Listen to ending Zoom webinars
nodes.notes: This node is listening to Zoom events and triggers when a webinar was ended.

nodes.name: URL Validation check
nodes.notes: Checks whether the call is Zoom's URL validation or a regular event.

nodes.name: Crypto
nodes.notes: Enter the Secret Token of your Zoom app here. Prepares the response for Zoom's URL validation.

nodes.name: Build Validation Body
nodes.notes: Builds the body for Zoom's URL validation.

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook (Validation)
nodes.notes: Sends the validation response back to Zoom.

nodes.name: Build Normal Event Body
nodes.notes: Builds the response body for regular events.

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook (Events)
nodes.notes: Answers Zoom immediately so the webhook does not time out.

nodes.name: Wait 60 seconds
nodes.notes: Gives Zoom time to make the past webinar report available.

nodes.name: Get past Zoom webinar participants
nodes.notes: Loads all participant pages of the past webinar (UUID double-encoded where Zoom requires it).

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const u = $('Listen to ending Zoom webinars').first().json.body.payload.object.uuid; const e = (u.startsWith('/') || u.includes('//')) ? encodeURIComponent(encodeURIComponent(u)) : encodeURIComponent(u); return 'https://api.zoom.us/v2/past_webinars/' + e + '/participants'; })() }}

nodes.name: Get past Zoom webinar absentees
nodes.notes: Loads all absentees (registered, never joined). Errors (e.g. webinar without registration) are ignored.

nodes.name: Aggregate and classify
nodes.notes: CONFIG: webinar topics, tag IDs and thresholds at the top. Classifies attended / fully attended / not attended.

nodes.name: Attended?
nodes.notes: True: joined the webinar. False: absentee or below the minimum attendance.

nodes.name: Lookup contact in KlickTipp
nodes.notes: Existing contact: only tags are added (no name overwrite). Not found: new contact is subscribed with name.

nodes.name: Tag existing contact as attended
nodes.notes: Existing contact: adds the attended tag, leaves name and subscription untouched.

nodes.name: Contact not found?
nodes.notes: Only the known 'not found' answer creates a new contact; any other lookup error stops visibly.

nodes.name: Fully attended?
nodes.notes: True if attended more than 90% of the actual webinar length (rejoins summed).

nodes.name: Tag fully attended
nodes.notes: Adds the full attendance tag.

nodes.name: Tag not attended
nodes.notes: Absentees and participants below the minimum attendance. Only existing contacts are tagged.
